# Vendored browser dependencies

These browser-ready files are pinned locally so the PWA works offline and does not rely on a CDN at runtime.

| Package | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lucide | 0.468.0 | ISC |
| Marked | 12.0.2 | MIT |
| DOMPurify | 3.1.6 | MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 |
| KaTeX | 0.16.11 | MIT |
| ical.js | 1.5.0 | MPL-2.0 |
| JSZip | 3.10.1 | MIT OR GPL-3.0 |

Files were downloaded from the corresponding pinned npm package through jsDelivr. KaTeX fonts are included under `fonts/`.
